New plan: I failed because I did not identify the correct verbs for the specific objects. I assumed "sulphy" worked on everything, but it only worked on the tulacy and ortid. For the pacia, sioust, unflued, and rist, I need to try the other available verbs ("latory", "tedne", "derman", "tuate", "chross") systematically. I also wasted time trying to interact with objects ("reele", "uncest") that were not visible in the current room. My new strategy is: 1) Upon entering a room, list all visible objects. 2) For each object, try the verbs in the order they were listed in the prompt ("latory", "tedne", "derman", "tuate", "chross", "sulphy") until one succeeds or all fail. 3) Only move to a new room after all objects in the current room are processed or deemed unactionable. 4) Repeat this process for every room until all three goals (tulacy enerk, menny soriced, ortid alism) are met.
